items.text: What's the first thing you noticed about me?
When did you first realise you liked me more than you were letting on?
What's a small thing I do that makes your day?
What's your favourite memory of us that you've never mentioned?
Which song reminds you of me, and why that one?
What's the most romantic thing you've wanted to do for me but haven't yet?
What went through your head the first time we kissed?
What's one thing about us you'd never change?
Were you nervous on our first date? What gave it away?
When have you felt proudest of us as a couple?
What's your idea of a perfect lazy Sunday with me?
What's the most attractive thing I do without realising it?
Which outfit of mine do you secretly love most?
When did you last think about kissing me when you should have been doing something else?
What's a flirty line you've thought about saying to me but held back?
What's your favourite way I've ever surprised you?
What's one thing you'd love me to do more often?
Which of my looks gets to you most?
What's the cheekiest thought you've had about me today?
What's something you've wanted to try with me but haven't asked?
What's your favourite memory of a night we spent together?
Where's the most unexpected place you've caught yourself thinking about me?
What could I whisper that would make you forget everything else?
Tonight, would you rather lead or be led — and why?
What's the boldest message you've ever almost sent me?
What compliment about the way you look would you love to hear more?
Describe a fantasy of yours in exactly three words.
What's something you'd love me to take over completely, just for tonight?
What role would you secretly love to play for a night?
What's the most intense moment we've shared, and what made it that way?
What rule would you set for me tonight if I promised to follow it?
What's something you've been curious about that you've never said out loud?
What's the fantasy you come back to most often?
How would you feel about giving me complete control for one night?
What's one thing you'd want me to do that you've never asked for?
If tonight had no limits except ours, what would you want?
What safe word would you trust — and what would you want to explore once we had one?
What's the most daring thing you've ever wanted us to do?
Give me a compliment you've never said before, looking me in the eye.
Hold my hand and tell me about your favourite day with me.
Slow dance with me for one whole song, no talking.
Do your best impression of me the day we met.
Write me a two-line poem, right now, and read it aloud.
Give me a thirty-second shoulder rub. Make it count.
Tell me three things you're grateful for about us.
Make me laugh in under a minute. Any means necessary.
Raise a glass of water and make a toast to us.
Hold eye contact with me for a full minute without laughing.
Hum a song that reminds you of us until I guess it.
Kiss me somewhere other than my lips.
Whisper something in my ear you'd never say out loud.
Hold my gaze for sixty seconds without laughing.
Send me a flirty message right now, even though I'm right here.
Show me how you'd flirt with me if we'd only just met.
Pick a song and dance for me like nobody's watching.
Give me the slowest kiss you can manage.
Tell me how you'd plan our next date if there were no budget at all.
Take off one thing you're wearing — you choose what.
Kiss my neck for ten seconds, then stop and make me wait.
Describe, in a whisper, how you'd like tonight to end.
Close your eyes and let me lead you anywhere in the room.
Give me a five-minute massage — and I get to set the pace.
Tease me for one minute without touching me at all.
Choose what I wear for the rest of the night.
For the next five minutes, do only what I tell you.
Put on a blindfold and guess where I'll kiss you next.
Tell me one fantasy, in detail, in a whisper.
Play a character I choose for the next ten minutes.
Set one rule for me that lasts until the end of the game.
Undress me one piece at a time, slower than you think you should.
Give me three commands. I'll follow each one — inside our limits.
Take complete control of the next ten minutes.
Act out the opening scene of a fantasy we've talked about.
Blindfold me, then do whatever you like for two minutes — inside our limits.
Show me — don't tell me — exactly how you want to be kissed.
Choose a safe word together, then make the next five minutes the boldest of the night.
What would you ask me for if you knew for certain I would say yes?
What was the exact moment tonight that you first wanted this, and what was I doing?
Would you rather be told, or asked? Answer honestly, then say why.
Ask me out loud for the thing you find hardest to ask for. In plain words.
Do the next thing at half the speed you want to, and do not stop when I ask.
Say exactly what you are doing, while you do it, without once tailing off.
How far do you want tonight to go, and where exactly would be too far?
Which one do you go back to when you are on your own, and what happens in it first?
Which night of ours do you tell yourself a better version of? What is different in it?
Hand me the next ten minutes. No questions, no negotiating, and nothing you have not already agreed to.
Take me to almost, then stop and do something else entirely for five minutes.
Start acting out the fantasy rather than describing it, and keep going until I stop you.
